THE NAME IS RIGHT AND THE GENERATION IS NOT: Giovanni's father Rosario was a bracciante still working in 1872, and a man fathering a child in 1820 would be past seventy-five by then. A grandfather-generation namesake is exactly what Sicilian naming custom predicts, and custom is not a document
